title: Find the Maximum
description: Read an integer n followed by n integers, and print the largest value. Valid indices run 0 to n - 1, so the last element lives at index n - 1, never n; accessing index n crashes. The comparison must start from the first element (not from 0), because all values can be negative. This problem establishes the C5 base skill of list traversal, indexing, and search.
constraints: Each of the n values satisfies -1000000000 <= value <= 1000000000
starter_code:
def find_max(nums):
    """Return the largest value in nums."""
    # TODO: traverse the list with valid indices 0..len(nums)-1
    raise NotImplementedError


def main():
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    nums = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    print(find_max(nums))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
input_format: First line: an integer n. Second line: n integers separated by spaces.
output_format: A single integer: the largest of the n values.
